newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola closes limit down in nearby contracts.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola closes limit down in nearby contracts.

text.p: WCE canola futures closed down the $10.00 limit in May and July contracts on aggressive long liquidation sparked by a sharp drop in CBOT soybeans.
"We were up with the beans and we came down with them too," one WCE oilseed trader said.
Floor sources said locals were aggressive sellers all day while commission houses were also featured liquidating longs.
July canola ended off $10.00 at $419.90. The market will trade under expanded $15.00 limits Monday through Wednesday.
Traders noted Japan bought between 4,000 and 5,000 tonnes of Canadian canola in an overnight tender.
Flaxseed ended sharply lower on spillover weakness from other oilseed markets with July off $6.70 at $343.00.
Western barley futures ended lower with commercials featured sellers as CBOT corn tumbled after an early advance.
"We were up early but then fell apart as the US (corn) market turned lower," one WCE feedgrain trader said.
July western barley ended off $1.30 at $139.00.
Feed wheat futures closed mostly lower with July off $1.30 at $167.00. July feedpeas ended up US$1.00 at $193.50.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except feed peas)
